coverage_notes.result: No newly verified, qualifying, nonduplicative U.S. food-access disruption in 12 bounded targeted searches and three direct page checks.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search indexes were dominated by older incidents, 2025 SNAP shutdown notices, resource listings, and undated agency pages. A newly announced local interruption may be indexed after this check; this is not exhaustive national coverage.
coverage_notes.action_limits: No approval, publication, schedule modification, task disabling, or production collector changes.
